example.title: Creek crossing culvert on Nuckolls County Road AA (replacement for the Stewart Bridge)
example.place: east of County Road 4600, Nuckolls/Clay county line, NE
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Culvert on Rd AA (Nuckolls County, Nebraska))

brief: Modern county-road replacement culvert: two parallel corrugated galvanized-steel pipes of about 5 ft diameter laid side by side under a gravel county line road, with short projecting ends and no headwalls, set in a grassy, snow-dusted ditch with dead weeds. Yellow object markers on posts at the road edges, a green road-name sign and utility poles; flat farmland and a farmstead with grain bins beyond. Only two photos exist.
